name: Coagulation Abnormality Associated with a Vascular Anomaly

criteria.description: Presence of a confirmed vascular anomaly by imaging or histopathology
Laboratory evidence of coagulation abnormalities such as low fibrinogen, elevated D-dimers, or thrombocytopenia
Clinical signs of bleeding or bruising disproportionate to trauma
Exclusion of other primary coagulation disorders or systemic diseases

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of a vascular anomaly confirmed by imaging or histopathology plus laboratory evidence of coagulation abnormalities with exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis often requires multidisciplinary evaluation including hematology and vascular specialists

pathognomonic.symptomName: Localized intralesional bleeding within vascular malformation
pathognomonic.notes: Bleeding confined to the vascular anomaly site
searchTerms: localized hemorrhage in blood vessel malformation
blood clotting disorder with low fibrinogen

common.symptomName: Localized pain and swelling due to vascular lesion expansion

searchTerms: bleeding lasts long after small cuts

occasional.symptomName: Anemia due to chronic blood loss
searchTerms: low red blood cells from bleeding
anemia due to chronic blood loss
small red spots near vascular lesion

occasional.symptomName: Localized warmth and erythema over vascular malformation
searchTerms: erythema and heat at vascular site

rare.symptomName: High-output cardiac failure secondary to large vascular anomaly
searchTerms: heart failure from large vascular anomaly
heart strain due to blood vessel malformation

rare.symptomName: Neurological deficits due to vascular anomaly compression
searchTerms: neurological symptoms due to lesion pressure
nerve deficits caused by vascular mass

imaging: MRI or ultrasound demonstrating vascular malformation
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; may be associated with somatic mutations in vascular anomaly genes

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of kaposiform hemangioendothelioma or tufted angioma
Rapidly enlarging vascular tumor in infancy

redFlags: Rapid enlargement of vascular lesion with worsening coagulopathy
Signs of systemic disseminated intravascular coagulation
